title: 1927 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship
text:
{{Short description|none}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox Hurling All-Ireland | year = 1927 | image = | dates = | teams = | connacht = | munster = Cork | leinster = Dublin | ulster = Antrim | matches = | poty = | team = Dublin | titles = 5th | captain = [[Mick Gill]] | manager = | team2 = Cork | captain2 = [[Seán Óg Murphy]] | manager2 = | totalgoals = | totalpoints = | topscorer = | previous = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1926|1926]] | next = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1928|1928]] }} The '''All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1927''' was the 41st series of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], [[Ireland]]'s premier [[hurling]] [[single-elimination tournament|knock-out competition]]. [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] won the championship, beating [[Cork GAA|Cork]] 4–8 to 1–3 in the [[1927 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|final]].{{cite web|url=http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |title=All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Roll of Honour |publisher=The GAA website |access-date=25 July 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110905085701/http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |archive-date=5 September 2011 }} ==Format== '''All-Ireland Championship''' ''Semi-final:'' (1 match) The winners of the Munster championship were drawn to play [[Galway GAA|Galway]], who received a bye to this stage of the championship. One team was eliminated at this stage while the winning team advanced to the final. ''Final:'' (1 match) The winners of the lone semi-final and the Leinster champions contested this game with the winners being declared All-Ireland champions. ==Results== ===[[Leinster Senior Hurling Championship]]=== {{football box |date=May 29 |team1=[[Laois GAA|Laois]] |score=2–1 – 4–7 |team2=[[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] |report= |goals1= |goals2= |stadium=Kilkenny |attendance= |referee= }} ---- {{football box |date=July 3
